# Upload to /frontend/.htaccess on server then rename
# Cafe24 Apache — React SPA (/frontend/ 서브경로)
RewriteEngine On
RewriteBase /frontend/

# 정적 파일은 그대로
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} -f [OR]
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} -d
RewriteRule ^ - [L]

# 나머지는 index.html (React Router)
RewriteRule ^ index.html [L]
